thread:
Maya Patel: Heads-up 10am PT tomorrow for a compact QBR run-through? want 12 slides max, 5 exec asks max.
Tom Wu: 10am works. can we trim the product roadmap slide? execs only care about immediate impact.
Lena Ortiz: I can condense roadmap to 1 "what's shipping next 90d" slide. will highlight items tied to adoption lift.
Samir Dhawan: renewal risk note: expansion usage down 22% month-over-month in the pilot group. I can add a short churn-driver list and remediation options.
cs-reminder-bot: Onboarding status for HelioCorp: 7/8 milestones complete  remaining: admin SAML + verification. ETA 36h. Reminder: attach onboarding checklist to pre-read.
Maya Patel: good catch Samir. let's propose two exec asks: 1) two-week training credit (technical + onboarding), 2) commit to a joint success SLA review. prefer #1 as primary ask, #2 as fallback.
Tom Wu: +1 to training credit. add estimated ARR impact of +6% if adoption rebounds (one-liner). I'll draft the ARP uplift bullet.
Lena Ortiz: demo owner here. planning a 2.5m live walkthrough + 1.5m Qs. need a quick dataset anonymized to run through. @Samir can you provide snapshot?
Samir Dhawan: will export a sanitized sample and share link by 6pm PT. also adding a little "what success looks like" slide with 3 metrics (DAU, conversion, time-to-value).
Maya Patel: action items: Tom -> uplift metric + 1-line ARR impact (slide 4). Lena -> demo script + recorded fallback (slide 5). Samir -> sanitized dataset + churn drivers slide (slide 3). Maya -> exec ask phrasing + pre-read one-pager. dry run 9:40am PT for 12-min walk.
Tom Wu: noted. will keep my bullet to 2 sentences.
Lena Ortiz: will add fallback steps in speaker notes: \n```
Fallback plan: 1) play 90s recorded demo clip, 2) surface ROI numbers, 3) propose a follow-up workshop next week.
```
Samir Dhawan: added short remediation timeline (30/60/90 days) to action tracker and assigned owners.
Maya Patel: share deck link here when updated and I'll send calendar invite + pre-read to execs. aim to finalize slides tonight EOD.
Tom Wu: :thumbsup: I'll review after 5pm.
Lena Ortiz: ack. will be ready for 9:40 dry run.
cs-reminder-bot: Note: please mark post-QBR follow-ups in the Customer Success board to ensure traceability.
Maya Patel: thanks team 12 key goal: concise ask + a single next-step for execs. see you tomorrow.
